name: Jeeter | Baja Breeze | 2G Liquid Diamond XL All-In-One Vape
description: Baja Breeze is a sativa strain bursting with sugary sweetness and crisp fruitiness reminiscent of a certain iconic lime soda from your favorite late-night drive-thru. Bright tropical and subtle floral notes round out its creamy vanilla-lime flavor, creating a smooth, refreshing profile that’s both nostalgic and just a bit más.
